release_notes: Session recordings now cover the offer half of the funnel. A page the tracker serves for a local offer (a ZIP uploaded to Orbitra, including Direct Local Offer streams) records like a landing: a visit that came through a landing continues that landing's recording and the player shows the hop to the offer, while a click sent straight to the offer records under the campaign-level switch (campaign - Integrations - Session recordings). Heatmap clicks from the offer land under the offer's own page path, kept apart from the landing's map by the page selector. The recorder is the only thing injected into offer pages: the LP dwell timer stays off (it would overwrite the landing's own engagement numbers), and so do conversion popups (an overlay over an order form is a conversion risk). External offers (a redirect to an affiliate URL) still cannot be recorded: the tracker does not serve that page. Partners wall: Telegram Expert desktop software and Huoxing Shop account store, with per-partner rel handling for sponsored links.
